0

Before each send · in Gmail

First, write a draft in Gmail

The tool takes one email you wrote earlier and sends it to many people at once. So step one is to write that email in Gmail, turning the bits that differ per person (like the name) into a {{field}}.

How to
  1. Open Gmail.
  2. Click Compose (top-left, 撰寫) to start a new email.
  3. Write the subject and the full body.
  4. For anything that differs per person, use a {{field name}}. For example, replace the name with {{name}} — the tool swaps in the real name later.
  5. No need to save — Gmail keeps it as a draft automatically. Just close it when done.
  6. Back in the tool, pick this draft under “Pick a draft” (選擇草稿) — that's Step 1 below.
You'll see
The email shows up in Gmail's Drafts, and appears in the tool's list too.

Both subject and body can use {{field}}

Many people think only the subject can change — not so. Anywhere you want it personalized, drop in a {{field}} and it'll be swapped when sending.

Copy-paste example

Paste the subject and body below into Gmail, then edit to fit your message.

Subject
Hi {{name}} — CAPSULE partnership invite
Body
Hi {{name}},

We'd love to invite you to {{event}}. The planned date is {{date}}.

The draft's {{field}} = the list's columns

Whatever {{field}} the draft uses, the list needs columns with the same names. The first column is always the recipient's Email.

Gmail draft
Subject
Hi {{name}} — CAPSULE partnership invite
Body
Hi {{name}},
We'd love to invite you to {{event}}.
Planned date: {{date}}.
List (spreadsheet)
Emailnameeventdate
abc@example.comAlex WangSpring Meetup2026/09/10
The draft uses {{name}}, {{event}}, {{date}}, so the list has “name, event, date” columns. The tool creates these columns for you — just fill in the data.

23 steps to send

Pick draft → fill list → preview & send

Once authorized, every send is these three steps.
Each one explains: what to do, where to click, what you'll see, and what trips people up.

1

Batch send · step 1 / 3

Pick a draft

This step finds the email you wrote earlier in Gmail. On the “Pick a draft” (選擇草稿) page, you'll mainly use the spots below (numbers match the screenshot):

  1. Search drafts (搜尋草稿)：when you have lots of drafts, type a few words (from the subject or body) to find the one you want fast.
  2. + New draft in Gmail (＋ 在 Gmail 開新草稿)：no draft yet? Open a new one to write here.
  3. Reload list (重新載入清單)：just wrote a draft but it's not in the list yet? Click here to refresh and it'll appear.
  4. Draft list (草稿清單)：click the one you want here to select it.

After you pick

The chosen draft lights up, and the “Next” (下一步) button at the bottom-right lights up too — click it to continue.

If the list is empty

Usually the draft hasn't been created yet. Go back to Step 0 to write one, then return here and it'll show.

Next: fill the list ↓
2

Batch send · step 2 / 3

Fill or import the list

This step tells the tool who to send to, plus each person's details. There are a few ways to fill the list — use whichever's easiest; you can even copy a block from a spreadsheet and paste it in:

  1. Import a spreadsheet：pick a frequent sheet from “Recent spreadsheets” (最近的試算表), or “Search others” (搜尋其他) to find one in your Drive — bringing in the whole list at once, no typing row by row.
  2. CC list (副本名單)：everyone listed here gets a CC on every email. To add or remove, edit the Gmail draft.
  3. + Add row (＋ 一列)：to add people one by one, click here for a new row.
  4. Clear all (全刪)：typed too much wrong and want to start over? Click here to clear it all.

After filling

Recipients list out one by one below, with “N recipients total” (共 N 筆收件人) at the bottom. If the number's right, you're good.

Two things to watch

The list's first column must be the recipient's Email — don't misplace it; and column names must match the draft's {{field}}, so the data lines up.

Next: preview & send ↓
3

Batch send · step 3 / 3

Preview & send

Last step. Before you hit send, look over a few things on this page:

  1. Send summary (寄送摘要)：shows the recipient count, chosen draft, and sender identity — check the count first.
  2. Preview email (預覽信件內容)：click to render the first email using the list's first row — confirm every {{field}} is swapped for real data.
  3. Sender identity (寄件身份)：choose who the email is sent as (your account, or a department mailbox).

Finally, choose when to send

  1. Send now / Schedule：to send right away pick “Send now” (立即寄出); to set a time pick “Schedule” (排程寄送).
  2. Scheduled time (預定寄送時間)：if you chose Schedule, pick the date and time here.

After you click Send

You'll see “Created #XX and sending started” (已建立 #XX 並開始寄送). For large lists it batches automatically, finishing within about 5 minutes.

Preview before sending

Skip the preview and sometimes a {{field}} doesn't get swapped (usually the column name doesn't match the draft). A quick preview saves the day.

Pre-send checklist

Tick each item before hitting Send
All checked — go ahead and hit Send!

3More & FAQ

More features & troubleshooting

This section covers advanced use and troubleshooting. For your first send, feel free to skip it.

CC recipients: add them in the draftfixed CCs don't need {{ }}

If every email CCs the same group, you don't need a {{ }} field. Just add the CC in the Gmail draft. On the “Fill the list” (填寫名單) screen, the “CC list” (副本名單) at the top shows them, and every recipient gets the CC. To change it, edit the Gmail draft.

Import the list from a spreadsheetbring in the whole list, no typing row by row

On the “Fill the list” screen, click “Recent spreadsheets” (最近的試算表) for a frequent sheet, or “Search others” (搜尋其他) to find another in Drive. The sheet's column names must match the draft's {{field}}, with Email in the first column. You can also copy a block and paste with Ctrl/⌘+V.

Send log & recent repliessee what went out, its status, and who replied

After a send, this is where you check whether it went out and whether anyone replied. Click “Send log” (寄送紀錄) at the top-right of the tool to open this page.

Send log: how each batch did

  1. Each row is one send: click the ▶ triangle on the left to expand and see who it went to.
  2. Counts: shows this batch's total, sent, and replies.
  3. Status: shows “Done” (已完成) once the whole batch is sent.
  4. Top buttons: switch to “Recent activity” (近期活動), go back to the send page (返回寄信頁面), or “Refresh” (重新整理) to update statuses.

Expand a row to see each person

  1. One row per recipient: see the status, send time, whether they replied, and any errors.
  2. View (檢視): open the actual email content, with every {{field}} already swapped for real data.
  3. Thread (信件串): jump to this conversation in Gmail, where you can reply or read on directly.

“View” shows you the email

  1. Email content: this is exactly what was sent, with every {{field}} filled with real data (here the name shows as “佩佩”).
  2. Close (關閉): done reading? Click here to go back to the log.

Recent activity: who replied

Switch to “Recent activity” (近期活動) up top to list replies from the last 30 days.

  1. Each row is one reply: see who replied, to which email, and when.
  2. Open (開啟): jump to that reply and read it in Gmail.

Replies are listed one by one

Each reply you receive adds another row - there is no limit on how many.

FAQ

QWhat does this tool actually do?
It takes one email you wrote in advance and sends it to the whole list at once. Thanks to {{field}}, each email auto-fills each person's name and details — not the same canned message for everyone.
QHow is it different from the old Excel version?
This web version replaces the old Excel workflow and does everything it did and more: auto-fill in emails, import lists from a spreadsheet, schedule sends, and a send log. Just use this from now on.
QCan only the subject change, or the body too?
Both. Anywhere you want it personalized, drop in a {{field}} and it's swapped at send time.
QI have no draft at all — what first?
Start with Step 0: in Gmail hit Compose (撰寫), write the subject and body, turn the changing bits into {{field}}. Gmail saves it as a draft automatically — then pick it in the tool.
QWhat about the red “Unverified” note?
It's normal — this is an internal tool that isn't publicly listed. On the auth screens, click “REVIEW PERMISSIONS → Continue (繼續) → Select all (全選) → Continue (繼續)”. It only asks the first time.
QA {{field}} didn't get swapped after sending?
Usually the list's column name doesn't match the draft's {{field}}, or that column is empty. Before sending, hit Preview and make sure every blank is filled with no leftover {{ }}.
QWill lots of recipients clog it up?
No. It batches automatically and finishes within about 5 minutes.
